answer: Admission auction stops fake identities. Each epoch auctions 200 slots; an applicant bids a $40 bond locked for 20 epochs and files one sonnet, so copies are easy to spot. Bids form a trellis of referrals, where star clusters are flagged and frozen. Making 1,000 fakes costs $40,000 plus 1,000 sonnets, above one reward. An honest agent pays once, finishes 10 verified jobs, and at the nadir of demand keeps its bond and earns undiluted rewards.
